marketing.headline: Your day, on your own machine.
marketing.body: Botvy keeps your tasks, meetings and reminders in one place — on your phone, in your browser, and on the web. It coaches, plans your week and reads what you save, using a language model that runs on your own hardware. Nothing leaves it.

day.title: A day that plans itself
day.body: Tasks, reminders and meetings in one list, with an evening prompt for tomorrow and a briefing in the morning — on your clock, wherever you are.

coach.title: A coach you can talk to
coach.body: Ask in your own words and it acts: a task, a reminder, a meeting, a note about yourself. It remembers what you told it.

training.title: A training week
training.body: Say when you train and the sessions appear. Log what you did, and the week fills itself in around it.

food.title: Ordinary food
food.body: Your own meals, or plain suggestions for the day — never a portion, never a calorie, and never something you told it you are allergic to.

reading.title: What you saved to read
reading.body: Paste a link and it reads it for you, then suggests a session drawn from what you actually saved.

marketing.downloadBody: The phone app and the browser extension are built from the same release. Both talk only to the Botvy you run.
marketing.privacyBody: On the machine you install it on. There is no Botvy service, no account with us, and nowhere else for your data to be.

privacyPoints.ownMachine: Your notes, tasks and conversations stay in your own database.
privacyPoints.ownModel: The language model runs locally — no request goes to a model provider.
privacyPoints.noAnalytics: No analytics, no tracking, and no third-party scripts on this page.

admin.title: Admin portal
admin.notAdmin: This account is not an administrator. Ask the Owner for the admin role.

login.title: Sign in
login.replay: That session was ended for security. Sign in again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.noJobsYet: No scheduled job has reported in yet. The relay stamps its first heartbeat within 30 seconds of the worker starting.
overview.defaultPassword: This installation still uses the seeded administrator password. Change it — the default is published in the setup guide.
overview.registrationExplain: Whether new members may create their own accounts. Takes effect on the next attempt; no redeploy.
overview.todayExplain: What the model has been asked to do since midnight in {zone}.

users.title: Members
users.name: Name
users.unbanned: Unbanned. They will need to sign in again — the ban ended their sessions.
users.banResult: Banned. {count, plural, =0 {No active sessions were ended} one {One session was ended} other {# sessions were ended}}.
users.gone: That account no longer exists. It has been removed from the list.

serviceClients.title: Service clients
serviceClients.explain: Machine callers. n8n holds one; anything else you integrate needs its own. Each secret is shown once and stored only as a hash.
serviceClients.name: Name
serviceClients.secretWarning: Copy this now. It is stored as a hash and cannot be shown again — if it is lost, revoke this client and create another.

ingestion.title: Reading queue
ingestion.intro: What Botvy is reading across the installation, what failed and why. The summaries are not shown here: the content of somebody's reading is not operational information.
ingestion.clearConfirm: Clear {url}? It leaves the member's list and its extracted text is erased. The clearing is recorded in the audit trail.

settings.title: Settings
settings.explain: Every operator knob, with what it means and what it is set to. A change takes effect on the next use — nothing restarts.

workflows.title: Automation
workflows.explain: The scheduled work, whether it is switched on, and when it last ran.
workflows.name: Workflow
workflows.notConfigured: No automation key is configured on this installation, so there is nothing to show. Set N8N_API_KEY and run the bootstrap to import the workflows.
workflows.unreachable: The automation tool is not answering, so this list cannot be shown. It is not empty — it is unknown.

usage.title: Model use
usage.explain: How much the model has been asked to do. Tokens, not money — this is here so a runaway loop is visible before it becomes a problem.
usage.utcNote: Days are counted in UTC, because this view spans every member at once.

audit.title: What changed
audit.explain: Every administrative act, with who did it and when.
